verdict.rationale: Unleash's pricing page says it can track stale feature flags with a dedicated dashboard, which covers the stale-flag half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows code-reference discovery or any tooling that helps remove flags from the codebase, and the stale-flag claim is a single pricing-page line with no in-depth docs. Missing for 10: code references / code scanning to locate flag usages, documented cleanup workflow for removing temporary flags, in-depth docs on stale-flag detection, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can find stale flags and code references so temporary flags actually get removed from the codebase

citations.quote: Track stale feature flags with a dedicated dashboard
